# cyanrip -V (/usr/bin/cyanrip, Ubuntu paket 0.9.2-1build3)
cyanrip 0.9.0 (release)

cyanrip 0.9.0 (release) help:

  Ripping options:
    -d <path>             Set device path
    -s <int>              CD Drive offset in samples (default: 0)
    -r <int>              Maximum number of retries for frames and repeated rips (default: 10)
    -Z <int>              Rips tracks until their checksums match <int> number of times. For very damaged CDs.
    -S <int>              Set drive speed (default: unset)
    -p <number>=<string>  Track pregap handling (default: default)
    -P <int>              Paranoia level, 3 to 0 inclusive, default: 3
    -O                    Enable overreading into lead-in and lead-out (may freeze if unsupported by drive)
    -H                    Enable HDCD decoding. Do this if you're sure disc is HDCD
    -E                    Force CD deemphasis
    -W                    Disable automatic CD deemphasis
    -K                    Disable ReplayGain tagging

  Output options:
    -o <string>           Comma separated list of outputs
    -b <kbps>             Bitrate of lossy files in kbps
    -D <string>           Directory naming scheme, by default its "{album}{if #releasecomment# > #0# (|releasecomment|)} [{format}]"
    -F <string>           Track naming scheme, by default its "{if #totaldiscs# > #1#|disc|.}{track} - {title}"
    -L <string>           Log file name scheme, by default its "{album}{if #totaldiscs# > #1# CD|disc|}"
    -M <string>           CUE file name scheme, by default its "{album}{if #totaldiscs# > #1# CD|disc|}"
    -l <list>             Select which tracks to rip (default: all)
    -T <string>           Filename sanitation: simple, os_simple, unicode (default), os_unicode

  Metadata options:
    -I                    Only print CD and track info
    -a <string>           Album metadata, key=value:key=value
    -t <number>=<string>  Track metadata, can be specified multiple times
    -R <int>/<string>     Sets the MusicBrainz release to use, either as an index starting from 1 or an ID string
    -c <int>/<int>        Tag multi-disc albums, syntax is disc/totaldiscs
    -C <title>=<path>     Set cover image path, type may be "Name" or a "track_number"
    -N                    Disables MusicBrainz lookup and ignores lack of manual metadata
    -A                    Disables AccurateRip database query and validation
    -U                    Disables Cover art DB database query and retrieval
    -G                    Disables embedding of cover art images

  Misc. options:
    -Q                    Eject tray once successfully done
    -V                    Print program version
    -h                    Print options help
    -f                    Find drive offset (requires a disc with an AccuRip DB entry)
